verdict.rationale: Gusto documents an API reference site covering its endpoints, a full OpenAPI 3.1 spec, and curl examples that run against a separate demo base URL, so examples can be executed against a sandbox. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference itself is interactive (for example an in-page try-it console). missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-browser API explorer, runnable examples embedded in the reference pages, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: This site serves as both a technical reference for the endpoints available and a general overview of payroll.
The demo environment runs against a separate base URL, https://api.gusto-demo.com (shown in curl examples in the versioning and getting-started guides).
The index page at https://docs.gusto.com/embedded-payroll/openapi lists "All OpenAPI Files for v2026-06-15" linking gusto-api.json.
